text:
Situation: Piperacillin and tazobactam is not on FDA's drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation on 2026-01-20. Current inventory across three sites provides 17.9 to 25.1 days on hand depending on presentation and location.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list shows piperacillin and tazobactam is not listed as of 2026-10-21. Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC posted a discontinuation for piperacillin and tazobactam injection on 2026-01-20.

Our position: Supply is adequate for the near term but relies on a single discontinued source. The rule-based check finds no FDA shortage posting before the registered plant action, so we must verify current supplier allocations and secure alternate manufacturers.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to contact Apotex Corp., Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc., B. Braun Medical Inc., Baxter Healthcare Corporation, and BluePoint Laboratories to confirm allocation availability and lead times; buyer approves purchase orders.
2. Buyer to request plant location details from each alternate manufacturer's regulatory affairs contact; buyer and quality assurance approve supplier qualification.
3. Pharmacy director to review alternate product labeling and compatibility with current infusion protocols; pharmacy director approves formulary addition.
4. P&T committee to review and approve alternate manufacturers for formulary addition at next scheduled meeting; committee chair signs approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
